pattern.description: After a hard cut from the previous headline to an empty off-white frame, the line 'without leaving Notion' builds word by word: each word fades in from light grey to near-black while rising a few pixels into place, staggered roughly 150-250 ms apart, with the last word 'Notion' landing last.
pattern.why_premium: Words arrive in step with the voice-over rhythm, and the grey-to-black fade plus small rise gives soft, readable motion on a plain background without any distracting effects.

build_hint.gsap: Split the line into words; gsap.fromTo(words, {opacity: 0, y: 12, color: '#b0b0b0'}, {opacity: 1, y: 0, color: '#111', duration: 0.5, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.18}). Start it right after a hard cut from the previous headline.
build_hint.remotion: Per word i: const p = spring({frame: frame - i*5, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}); opacity = p; translateY = interpolate(p, [0,1], [12,0]); color is interpolated from grey to black on p. No overshoot.

notes: The outgoing headline 'Access all your company's knowledge' hard-cuts out at f590 (energy spike). It is not on the end frame, so it has no box and is not listed. b02 ('Notion') sits inside b01; b01 is used for the line-level word stagger and b02 for the last word. The small rise is inferred from the filmstrip (at f612 'Notion' sits slightly lower and lighter).
